test_title: PYST 40 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the best option to replace the underlined part to improve the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select 'No substitution.'

He was __accused for stealing__ confidential data.
solution:
The correct answer is '**2**' i.e. 'Accused of stealing.'
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The verb "**accused**" is always followed by the preposition "**of**" when indicating the reason for the accusation.
 
• The phrase "**accused for stealing**" is incorrect because "for" is not the correct preposition to use after "accused."
 
• The correct structure is "**accused of + gerund/noun**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"He was accused of stealing confidential data."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Accused with stealing"** is incorrect because "with" is not the correct preposition to use after "accused."
 
• **Option 3: "Accused to stealing"** is grammatically incorrect as "to" is not the appropriate preposition for this context.
 
• **Option 4: "No substitution"** is incorrect because the original sentence contains an error and needs correction.
